items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: I saw Jerry Jerome... he says, 'Go to the Nola Studios and tell them I suggested you talk to him.'

ctx.x: So you had decided by this time that I’m a musician and this is what I’m doing for the rest of my life?
Oh yeah, no, I was being a professional, I thought I was a professional, and then I saw Jerry Jerome, I don’t know if you recall that name.
